stations.title: Order form
stations.text: Turns bad orders away, but nothing tests it.

captions: Someone ordered a huge box from Thistlecombe Farm, and it reached the packing list.
The order form should turn bad orders away, and nothing checks that it does.
You test that bad orders throw the right error, and that good ones go through.
Now a huge box is turned away at the form, and good orders still reach Wendell.
Same form, same rules. It says no to bad orders and yes to good ones.
